mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM channel_call_record r WHERE

SELECT CAST(r.id AS VARCHAR) AS "id", r.call_id AS "callId", r.caller AS "caller", r.caller_name AS "callerName", r.customer_no AS "customerNo", r.session_no AS "sessionNo", r.ticket_no AS "ticketNo", r.status AS "status", r.ivr_path AS "ivrPath", r.ivr_label AS "ivrLabel", r.duration_seconds AS "durationSeconds", r.recording_url AS "recordingUrl", r.agent_name AS "agentName", r.transcript AS "transcript", r.asr_text AS "asrText", r.asr_status AS "asrStatus", r.asr_hint AS "asrHint", r.asr_time AS "asrTime", r.event_count AS "eventCount", r.first_event_time AS "firstEventTime", r.answer_time AS "answerTime", r.hangup_time AS "hangupTime", r.create_time AS "createTime" FROM channel_call_record r WHERE ORDER BY r.create_time DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
